ops.title: Recovery path for a pending replacement commit whose Next program vanished
ops.description: Residual from the 2026-07-24 lenient-load change (adversarial review attack line 2b): with Desired==Applied==commit.Next persisted and the program deleted, Converge stays blocked by the pending commit and acknowledgement requires that exact dead plan loaded — the tool is constructible (better than the pre-change load wedge) but stuck. Needs an abandon/recover primitive for the commit fence. See note a362a2a for the root-cause context.

ops.text: A persisted ReplacementCommit whose Next plan program no longer exists can be abandoned or recovered without resurrecting the old path
Converge is no longer permanently blocked by such a commit; covered by a controller-level test
